name: UI：任务管理-任务行操作按钮验证
description: 验证任务表格每行的操作按钮：分配明细/详情/编辑/下载，文案正确且可点击

steps.expression: (() => { const actionLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a, button')).filter(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); return ['分配明细', '详情', '编辑', '下载'].some(k => t.includes(k)); }); return actionLinks.map(a => ({ text: a.textContent.trim(), tag: a.tagName, href: a.href || '' })); })()

steps.description: 断言至少有一个操作按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const actions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a, button')).filter(el => ['分配明细', '详情', '编辑', '下载'].some(k => el.textContent.trim().includes(k))); const texts = actions.map(a => a.textContent.trim()); const expected = ['分配明细', '详情', '编辑', '下载']; const found = expected.filter(e => texts.some(t => t.includes(e))); return { expected, found, coverage: found.length + '/' + expected.length }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在至少一条任务数据。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 操作列含4个按钮：分配明细(蓝色链接)、详情(蓝色链接)、编辑(蓝色链接)、下载(蓝色链接)。
riskPoints: 任务无数据时操作列不显示
